name: Incubation Druid
oracle_text:
{T}: Add one mana of any type that a land you control could produce. If this creature has a +1/+1 counter on it, add three mana of that type instead.
{3}{G}{G}: Adapt 3. (If this creature has no +1/+1 counters on it, put three +1/+1 counters on it.)
blocked_sentences: {T}: Add one mana of any type that a land you control could produce. If this creature has a +1/+1 counter on it, add three mana of that type instead.

needs.what: a reflecting mana ability (`add_mana` with `reflecting` + `any_type`) whose output is scaled by a board-reading `amount`, so N mana of the one reflected type is produced; here amount = {"sum": [{"const": 1}, {"times": [{"const": 2}, {"min": [{"counters_on": {"counter": "+1/+1", "objects": {"self_only": true}}}, {"const": 1}]}]}]} (1, or 3 with a +1/+1 counter)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The loader's reflecting branch (cards/loader/__init__.py, the `reflect is not None` arm of the mana-ability build) hard-sets mana_amount = None, so an `amount` beside `reflecting` is never read and the ability always taps for exactly one mana; `any_one_color` and `split` honour `amount` but offer all five colours rather than what your lands could produce, and an `if` on counters is not allowed inside a mana ability
